reviews.title: I had a bad experience.
reviews.text: This app is really disappointing especially considering it was recommended by apple. Im not sure if everyone had the same experience I had, but this app constantly tries to get you to buy their subscription with pop up ads even if you already subscribed. I bought the subscription with a free trial and when I tried to export my video with the pro features I now had, the pop up ad still shows up! Theres a restore purchases button on the ad itself so every time I get the ad I press it of course. Pressing restore purchases on the pop up doesn’t do anything but close the ad and when trying to export videos with a pro subscription you still get a watermark even if you disabled the option to have one. That happening seems like a design choice and if you don’t like apps with pop up ads this app isn’t for you. All this is coming from an average person just casually trying an app.

Every time I email the app, they send me to Apple support. False information was provided and I would like my money back.

reviews.title: Ruined for creators. Removed basic features and added watermarks.
reviews.text: I used to love using this app, but a recent update completely ruined the user experience. They have severely limited the editing options for free users, and worst of all, they completely removed the ability to adjust the ratio aspect—making it totally useless for formatting YouTube Shorts or TikToks. On top of stripping away essential tools, they now force a massive, distracting watermark right over the center of your video. Taking away basic features just to force a paid subscription is a terrible move. I'm deleting the app and switching to CapCut. Avoid this one.
